instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor. Analyse the company profile and survey responses, then respond ONLY with a valid JSON object containing maturity_score, opportunities, next_steps, and key_weaknesses.

answers.companyDescription: Forge.com is a specialized cybersecurity consultancy focusing on deep technical services including penetration testing, SOC 2 compliance audits, and comprehensive incident response retainers for enterprise clients. They leverage a team of 12 certified ethical hackers and compliance experts to deliver bespoke security solutions across various industries. The company operates globally, utilizing a matrix structure that balances centralized governance with agile business unit execution.
answers.pastInitiatives: We installed IoT sensors on 40% of our production equipment to monitor utilization and predict failures. The pilot showed a 15% reduction in unplanned downtime on instrumented machines. We now have a business case approved for full fleet rollout, but procurement and integration with our legacy maintenance system are proving more complex than anticipated.
answers.strategicGoals: We are heavily dependent on a single product category and a concentrated customer base — our top 3 clients represent 55% of revenue. This concentration risk is unacceptable for our long-term health. We need to identify and develop new revenue streams, possibly including new product lines for different customer segments or entirely new business models that leverage our existing capabilities.
answers.additionalContext: New data localization requirements in our second-largest market will force us to re-architect our cloud infrastructure within 12 months to maintain operating licenses. This is a non-discretionary technical project that will consume significant engineering capacity. Innovation initiatives must be sequenced around this mandatory work or find ways to turn the migration itself into a modernization opportunity.
answers.teamSize: We have a corporate innovation division with 50+ staff spanning research scientists, engineers, designers, and strategy professionals. The division manages a portfolio of 15 active innovation projects at various maturity stages, from early-stage research collaborations with universities to near-commercialization products. Annual innovation budget is managed through a formal portfolio governance process with stage-gate funding decisions.

opportunities.title: AI-Enhanced Vulnerability Prioritization Engine
opportunities.rationale: Integrate machine learning models into the existing automated reporting dashboard to move beyond simple risk scoring and provide predictive prioritization based on real-time threat intelligence. This enhances the core product offering without requiring a complete platform overhaul.

first_actions: Complete PoC for ML integration using internal threat data within Q1
Allocate 2 engineers (0.4 FTE) to the pilot project budget.
execution_plan.success_metric: Reduction in false positive alerts by 25% within the pilot scope.
milestones: MVP feature release for prioritization engine

opportunities.title: Managed Security Platform (SaaS Pivot)
opportunities.rationale: Shift from project/retainer-based consultancy to a high-volume, recurring subscription SaaS offering. This strategy diversifies revenue and addresses the concentration risk by targeting SMBs or specific industry verticals with standardized security modules.

first_actions: Conduct market segmentation study for niche vertical SaaS clients
Secure a seed round of $500k to build core platform MVP.
resources_needed: Initial marketing and sales development spend ($150k)
execution_plan.success_metric: Achieve 5 paying recurring customers by end of Year 2.
milestones: Define minimum viable product for subscription tier
Secure initial strategic partnership for channel distribution

next_steps.action: Establish a cross-functional steering committee focused solely on evaluating the feasibility and roadmap for the Managed Security Platform (Radical Opportunity)
Begin scoping and resource allocation for the AI-Enhanced Vulnerability Prioritization Engine PoC.

key_weaknesses: High budget constraint (10% innovation spend) limiting large, capital-intensive radical projects
Reliance on a single product category and concentrated customer base creating significant revenue concentration risk
Partial and decentralized innovation process leading to inconsistent adoption of new tools across business units
Slow incorporation of complex but high-value customer feedback (e.g., NPS data) into the long-term R&D pipeline
